name: Evernote
tagline: Note-taking app with web clipping, rich formatting, and cross-device sync
verdictSummary: A rich-text note editor with full-text search and file attachments is a straightforward CRUD app. Markdown-based notes stored in a database with a WYSIWYG editor (TipTap or similar) gives you 90% of what most people use Evernote for. The web clipper is harder, but a browser extension can handle it.
coreLoopDIY: Rich-text note editor with notebooks, tags, full-text search, and file attachments
moatNotes: Users with thousands of notes face significant friction to migrate — that's the real retention moat
whyPeopleStillPay: Years of notes already stored in Evernote — migrating thousands of notes with attachments is painful

priorArt.name: Joplin
priorArt.desc: Open-source note app with markdown and sync

notes: Joplin is a great open-source alternative if you don't want to build your own
